claimBoundary: one physical arm64 Mac and one variable-delay synthetic Fovea source timeline only
comparison is Fovea targetTimestamp external scheduling versus Fovea automatic deadline scheduling, not a third-party player ranking
source-frame state is sampled from the same view-bound NSView.displayLink.timestamp coordinate for both modes; this is committed-frame refresh observation, not hardware pixel scanout timing
six fixed pairs use alternating order and no retry-until-success path
primary directional metrics are playback-start-anchored p95 absolute transition timing error and raw observed skipped source frames; maximum-FPS-derived missed/early counts are supplemental only
no energy, thermal, memory, startup, codec, cross-player, physical-iOS, or cross-platform superiority claim

protocol.pairOrder: odd pairs external-then-deadline; even pairs deadline-then-external
protocol.retryPolicy: none; all fixed runs are preserved
protocol.observerCoordinate: NSView.displayLink callback timestamp; current committed source-frame index sampled before external mode offers the future targetTimestamp
protocol.externalClockRole: the same view display link is observer plus targetTimestamp playback driver
protocol.deadlineClockRole: the view display link is observer-only; AnimationPlaybackDriver remains automaticDeadlineLoop
protocol.playbackStartAnchor: AnimationPlaybackDriver exact clock.now value retained package-internally and bound by W5_PT_148
protocol.actualRefreshCadenceRule: record every positive display-link interval; do not infer actual cadence from NSScreen.maximumFramesPerSecond

refreshCadenceObservation.observedMedianIntervalInterpretation: all retained runs report 16,666,625 ns median intervals, approximately 60 Hz despite maximumFramesPerSecond=120; maximum-FPS-derived missed/early counts are therefore not a primary gate

supplementalResults.anchoredMissedEarlyCountsBoundary: retained for diagnostic compatibility only; the primary directional gate excludes missed/early counts because the fixed 1/maxFPS tolerance is not the observed refresh period

rejectedMeasurementCoordinates.reason: presenter commit callbacks mix future-target external timing with current/deadline timing and produced systematic early events; not a fair presentation-timing coordinate
first-observation phase normalization leaves startup-to-first-refresh phase unbound and did not record actual per-refresh intervals; retained as an intermediate artifact, not the final timing claim

conclusion.supported: On this exact physical-Mac protocol, targetTimestamp external scheduling is directionally better than the automatic-deadline control on both preregistered primary metrics: every pair has no-worse start-anchored p95 transition timing error and no-worse skipped source frames; the six-run medians are 14,102,375 ns versus 75,461,355 ns and total skips are 0 versus 82.
conclusion.notSupported: This does not establish hardware scanout timing, energy or thermal non-inferiority, memory superiority, third-party player ranking, physical-iOS performance, released-product integration, or global Pareto dominance.

nextGates: retain refresh-timing capture contract in iteration/premerge/release verification
collect physical-Mac energy and thermal evidence in separate non-perturbing runs before a scheduler Pareto claim
run stable physical-iPhone timing/memory/offscreen/energy/thermal evidence when the device is online
publish and pin the exact ImageCraft animation revision before encoded-native production startup/ranking claims
